is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis, An. gambiae s.s.) as stated in the abstract and methods.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F) and Vgsc L995S (L1014S) in Table 4 and Table 5.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for both L1014F and L1014S, broken down by species and survival status.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study location is specified as Yamaltu Deba, Gombe State, Nigeria, with coordinates (10° 13′ 0″ N, 11° 23′ 0″ E).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The collection period is explicitly stated as August to November 2018.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes in 2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Yamaltu Deba, Nigeria, in 2018. It reports bioassay results and genotype frequencies for kdr mutations L1014F and L1014S across An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis, and An. gambiae s.s.
